item.description: WIKKITIMES, Northern Nigeria’s leading investigative and accountability journalism platform, through its media development arm, the WikkiTimes Media Foundation, is seeking entries for its Anas Aremeyaw Anas AI Accountability Fellowship (A3AIA).
